View Our Work What Our Clients Say Can’t say enough good things about our experience with Paradise Pools Of Texas. The process was smooth start to finish, and everything was finished on time. Even after completion the line of communication is open. Will definitely be using them on any future projects! Josephine Furcini I LOVE MY POOL. Grateful for finding paradise pools of Texas. The owner was able to beat any other quote I received from other companies! Very affordable and easy to work with. I wanted something a little more modern and had a small backyard to work with and he nailed it! I loved his ideas about the different types of pool lights, and the fire pit on top of waterfall. Everything was exactly what I was looking for and I was included in every step of the process. Great quality pool, my friends and family love it! Also he beat the timeline I wanted as well! I was swimming within 2 months of construction start! Grace Litman I recommend Paradise Pools I work with Matt and he was responsive. I could call him, or send a text. If he didn’t answer my call, he’d call me back in like a few minutes. He respond to all the text messages, almost too quickly.. it was Easter Sunday, and he was reaching out, asking how it’s looking. He went above and beyond, he was exceptional. We needed to replace some pipes, I said to replace the minimum that needed to be replaced, and in the end, they replaced every single pipe because it was gonna look better, and charged me nothing extra. He was easy, and straight to the point. He really look out for what was best for us, I wanted to do a modification to my spa, even though it was a costly project, he said it was not necessary, and was very honest. I would totally work with them again. Christopher Duran The team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, delivering a high-quality pool within the agreed timeframe. Their attention to detail, communication, honesty, and expertise exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend their services for anyone seeking a reliable and skilled pool contractor. Trisha Phoupardit Great service and great quality pool. Entire process was really smooth and we are so happy with the result. He also gave us the best quote by far! Samantha Smith Matt is awesome! He always provides great customer service and gives detailed information about the project! data.summary: The available reviews are uniformly perfect and lack detail, all posted around the same time. The absence of ratings on other platforms and the lack of any critical feedback are concerning. This pattern suggests the reviews may be inauthentic or heavily curated, rather than a natural reflection of customer experience.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no constructive feedback
All reviews posted 'a year ago' (lack of recent activity)
Reviews are uniformly positive and lack specific project details
Low total review count for a contractor with multiple listings
No negative or mixed reviews found
authentic_signals: Reviews mention general positive attributes (communication, timeline, quality)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Perfect 5.0 rating on Google with only 4 reviews, but no ratings or reviews found on other major platforms (Yelp, BBB, Angi, Houzz). This suggests a limited and potentially curated online presence.
